task_meta.title: Fix an order-export importer that chokes on (and mis-totals) the real export file

claim_text:
`python -m importer exports/orders_2024-09.csv` now runs. The September total is **£28,478.53**, which matches the `TOTAL` line at the bottom of the export to the penny. August still gives the same result as before (5,442.35). All 11 tests pass.

| Customer | Sept total |
|---|--
digest: Read 8 files (8 before its first edit), made 1 edit, ran tests 8 times; re-ran them after its last edit.
